## Expertise

- Network Infrastructure: Cisco ACI, UCS, HyperFlex, Meraki, enterprise switching and routing
- Cybersecurity: Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, Zero Trust architecture, SIEM, IDS/IPS, network segmentation
- Cloud: AWS (Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Amplify, Bedrock), Azure AD, Microsoft 365, multi-cloud
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions
- Development: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, serverless architectures
